rationale: The original thesis relied on the declining 5-minute 9-EMA acting as dynamic resistance, but the current price ($234.56) has broken and is holding above the 9-EMA ($234.31). Over the last four 1-minute candles, price has formed a series of higher lows and higher closes, showing upward absorption rather than rejection at resistance. With the setup failing to roll over in an extremely strong broad market (SPY +4.87%), closing immediately preserves the remaining daily loss budget ahead of the $235.10 invalidation level.
